page.overview:
Who is Cellandra?

Cellandra was a talented young Sister of Sigmar who proved instrumental in defending her warband of sisters who were attacked by witch hunters while trying to recover relics from a Sigmarite temple in the ruins of Mordheim.

When Sister Cellandra was still a novice of the Sisters of Sigmar she proved to be very petulent and difficult to handle. After attempting to escape, she was sentenced to lashing that was administered by Sister Superior Guinevieve Benedictine. Benedictine noted that Cellandra took the lashes without protest and did not cry out in pain, which impressed the Sister Superior.

During initiate weapon discipline, Cellandra proved to be very talented at using the sling and the hammer.

While Cellandra proved to be very adept at martial training her spiritual training was noticeably lacking. Eventually Benedictine began to personally oversee Cellandra's training. In advanced weapons training, Benedictine noted how frightening Cellandra was at using the flail and steel whip.
